predictions: Alright, on a little bit of a better roll now. After a slow decline from week 1 to week 4, I've now popped off a couple pretty good ones, with back-to-back 19-7 weeks. That brings me to 104-52 (66.7% correct) so far, so at least I'm getting twice as many right as I get wrong. Sadly, I somehow had ANOTHER match of the week show up shorthanded last week… maybe I am somehow dooming my winning pick in the first match? Hmmm… maybe that curse could actually be a bit useful.

Match of the week: (A Div.) Show Me Your Tips @ Element W. Here it is, undefeated vs. undefeated at the top of the league. Exactly what roughly everybody wants to see every season. And it's not every day that local league matches are directly affected by stuff like the WDF Cup, but, here we are. In the end though, this might well be ok news for Element, as basically ALL the pressure is now on Show Me. They put together the team they wanted, they fought to the showdown, and now they get lucky matchup timing based on things bigger than RDL. Simply can't waste a chance like this. I'm still picking my guys, because that's just what I do, but all logic should point the other direction. 13-11.

Match #2: (C Div.) Liquor Possee @ Mulligan's Mafia. With the Bandits' stunning upset of the Possee last week, this pairing has just become a heads-up battle for lone possession of the C lead. I'm not sure how the Mafia turns their 0.500 singles into doubles dominance, but that's exactly their m.o. Still, I think the Possee rebounds, 13-11.

Match #3: (E Div.) Dartifacts @ Runs with Corks. The Dartifacts just gave up the race advantage to Ton 80 last week, and now they have to face the third place that is hunting them down. The Corks some- times seem to be all over the place for me, so I never know which version to expect. Thus, I'll go with the Dartifacts' consistency, 14-10.

Match #4: (D Div.) Main Street Mayhem @ One Dart Wonders. I had pretty much decided to just pick Mayhem every week so they have to lose to fool me, but I think they might not be at full strength for this one, sooo… I'm setting up myself up for failure. Again. Wonders, 13-11.

Match #5: (G Div.) Shark Shooters @ She-nanigans. There are still two teams ahead of this pair in the G race, but they aren't that far ahead. So a win here could still make somebody a player in this race. I'm thinking I'll ride the doubles strength of the Shooters here, 14-10.

Matches #6 & #7: (B Div.) Village Idiots @ Darty Little Secrets; Double In Stumble Out @ Dart Attack. In B division, there is one undefeated team, one winless team, and a huge mess of people all jumbled up in the middle. All teams not at the extremes have either 2 or 3 losses, so roughly anyone could make a run at second place, or… a run at next-to-last. Eek. I'm guessing the Secrets reel in the Idiots, 13-11; and Dart Attack will be able to avoid Stumbling, 14-10.
Match #8: (D Div.) Bottoms Up @ Duck Fook. With the Bottoms falling two weeks ago, the Ducks have new title hope life. That is, until the Bottoms continue reestablishing order here. Bottoms, 15-9.
Match #9: (F Div.) Sofa Kings @ Sharky's Machine. It feels like Dartness and Nein Mark are a long way ahead, but the winner here is still maybe going to be that third wheel. Machine maybe? 13-11?

Match #10: (E Div.) Red-eye Rangers @ Dart Knights. Yeah, I'll admit I didn't foresee this being a key matchup in determining who will likely fall to F in the spring. But it is what it is. Knights, 14-10.
Match #11: (C Div.) Darty Sanchez @ Shooter McGavin. Does one of these two have a run at the leaders in them? Or is this just helping determine C's bottom two? I think McGavin takes it, 13-11.

Match #12: (G Div.) Bright Side of Flights @ Throwin' on the Bayou. The Bayou just joined the win column, and they are looking to build on that. Which might be kind of key since this match looks to be critical in that oh-so-important unspoken race. Bright, 13-11.
